text: The follow-up sets the README tag and origin.revision to 3.11.1, but origin.release remains tag 3.8.1. Version numbers remain 3.11.1 while the distribution Git/date/type stamps become None, 0 and unreleased. These are distinct metadata fields, not a verified runtime version or archive comparison. Three separate script mode changes preserve exact blob identity; no unchanged script behavior is studied.
title: The Botan vendoring follow-up changes tracking metadata and resets distribution stamps
